object.content:
Over the weekend I installed a light in the only hallway closet. My dad bought this light back in 2007 hoping to get around to it, but never did. They've been using flashlights or battery-powered lights that stick on the wall for the past few decades.

It wasn't too bad to install, but running the power was a pain, because the only available power around it is only on when the lights in the attic are on. For that reason I had to run the power from the attic down into the basement, into and around some duct work.

All that's missing is a switch. I've been working on an automatic switch for this closet for quite some time. Now that the light is installed, I have to finish that project up ASAP because what good is a light without a light switch?
